headline: Despite a Turbulent Art Week, the Paris Auctions Delivered Stellar Results
summary: Hsiao Chin ’s Pintura 5 (Painting 5) (1958) sold for €374,100, far surpassing its €50,000 low estimate. L022 sold for €15,600, roughly double its €6,000-8,000 estimate. Earlier in the sale, another late Monet, La maison à travers les roses , also fresh to the market, sold mid-estimate for €2,545,000, while La Seine à Vernon, l’arbre reached €4.2 million against a €1.2-1.8 million estimate.
